text:
Dana: Heads up — we've been seeing streaming token stalls that look like mid-response pauses (tokens stop for 2-5s then resume). 95th token latency spiking from ~120ms to ~2.5s on ~5% of requests. Affected clusters: us-west-2 (primary), occasional spikes in eu-west-1. Could be east-west jitter/reordering inside the GPU pools. @eng-sre any ideas? :thinking:

Alex: Saw the same behavior on a dedicated pool last night. TCP retransmits and dup ACKs in the trace. Can you attach a pcap from one of the affected nodes and the NIC model?

Dana: Attaching short log excerpt and node info:

```
[2026-02-24T13:18:21Z] stream: token_sent idx=142 latency=120ms
[2026-02-24T13:18:24Z] stream: token_pause idx=143 wait=2300ms
[2026-02-24T13:18:25Z] rpc: deadline_exceeded route=stream-write
node: gpu-pool-12-azb (10.0.4.12)
nic: Intel X710-DA2 (ixgbe)
```

I uploaded pcap to the thread (s3://redwood-debug/pcaps/gpu-pool-12-20260224.pcap).

infra-bot: ALERT: network_flap detected on asg-gpu-pool-12 at 1767770419. dropped_packets=230, interface=eth0

Ben: My first guess is MTU/offload mismatch + packet reordering at the NIC/TOE layer. On 100G gear we've seen GRO/GSO coalesce reorder that confuses the streaming/ACK timing. Run these on the host: 

```
ethtool -k eth0
ethtool -S eth0 | egrep "rx_.*drop|tx_.*drop|rx_.*reorder"
sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_moderate_rcvbuf
```

If GRO/GSO/GRO/TSO look suspicious, try toggling off GRO/GSO as a canary.

Carl: I reproduced a similar symptom with netem locally — a small reorder + jitter pattern causes token gaps even without packet loss. Quick repro:

```
# adds 0-10ms jitter and 5% reordering
sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 1ms 10ms distribution normal reorder 5% 50%
```

Mitigations: 1) short-term: increase rpc streaming deadline from 3s -> 6s and route new streams to same-rack hosts (reduce east-west hops). 2) Medium: roll driver update + toggle offloads on suspected NICs and observe. 3) Long-term: consider kernel TCP tweaks (reordering window) and/or enable per-stream keepalive/heartbeat tokens so clients can detect mid-stream stalls faster.

Alex: Note — RDMA/SRDV-related features were disabled on those instances, SR-IOV not in use. We saw similar reorder when the host driver had an old firmware that mishandled large skbs and GSO. Plan: schedule canary reboot of 6 nodes in us-west-2 with updated driver 5.10.0-103, toggle off GRO on canary, and collect pcaps before/after. I'll also try enabling per-request small ACKs on the streaming layer for a canary.

Dana: Sounds good. I'll do the routing fallback for new sessions to us-west-2a and raise the RPC deadline to 6s for the canary rollout window. Adding follow-ups: collect ethtool -k, kernel ring stats (ss -s), and tcpdump for the canary nodes. Will post results here once done. Thx everyone :thumbsup:
